title_en: Xu Zhonghe and Fan Ganzhao — bribery, embezzlement, and misappropriation of public funds case

full_text_en:
Xu Zhonghe and Fan Ganchao: Bribery, Embezzlement, and Misappropriation of Public Funds

Defendant Xu Zhonghe, male, 56 years old, formerly Mayor of the People's Government of Ruzhou City, Henan Province, arrested on February 7, 1991.

Defendant Fan Ganchao, male, 40 years old, formerly Deputy General Manager of the Pingdingshan Coal Industry General Company, Henan Province, arrested on June 9, 1991.

The Pingdingshan Municipal People's Procuratorate of Henan Province instituted a public prosecution against defendant Xu Zhonghe for bribery and embezzlement, and against defendant Fan Ganchao for embezzlement, bribery, offering bribes, and misappropriation of public funds before the Pingdingshan Intermediate People's Court. The Pingdingshan Intermediate People's Court conducted a public trial and found the following facts:

In August 1988, defendant Xu Zhonghe was transferred to serve as Acting Mayor of Ruzhou City, Henan Province, while still concurrently serving as Director of the Liyuan Mining Bureau and Secretary of its Party Committee. The co-defendant Fan Ganchao, then Deputy Director of the Bureau, intending to curry favor with Xu Zhonghe, prepared to purchase a car for him. In November of the same year, Fan made a special trip to the Tongling City Steel Plant in Anhui Province and the Qianjiang Beer Factory in Zhejiang Province, both of which had coal sales business relationships with the Liyuan Mining Bureau, and caused each factory to make a gratuitous contribution of RMB 100,000, which was remitted to the Ningbo Sales Office of the Liyuan Mining Bureau. In April 1989, Xu Zhonghe, accompanied by his wife and children and escorted by Fan Ganchao, went on an "inspection tour" to the south. Before departure, Fan Ganchao instructed Zhu Delong (separately prosecuted), the contractor of the Ningbo Sales Office and an individual coal dealer, to withdraw cash from the funds remitted by the two factories and to prepare some gold to welcome Xu Zhonghe, at the same time promising Zhu Delong that he would be allowed to sell more coal in the future. Between April 10 and April 26, 1989, during his "inspection tour" in the south, Xu Zhonghe accepted from Zhu Delong: RMB 220,000 in cash; 8 gold ingots valued at over RMB 26,000; and one video cassette recorder. He also accepted from the Songling Town Water Supply and Drainage Company of Wujiang City, Jiangsu Province, which had business relations with the Liyuan Mining Bureau, 6 gold rings valued at over RMB 4,800. After Xu Zhonghe returned to Ruzhou, he also accepted one set of rosewood furniture, valued at over RMB 14,000, which Fan Ganchao had instructed others to purchase in Shanghai.

In March 1990, defendants Xu Zhonghe and Fan Ganchao conspired to demand money from Zhu Delong. On May 2, 1990, Zhu Delong delivered a bag containing RMB 170,000 in cash to Fan Ganchao at the Liyuan Mining Bureau in Ruzhou City. Fan Ganchao had this bag delivered to Xu Zhonghe's home through Xu's driver. On November 16 of the same year, Xu Zhonghe again demanded and obtained RMB 40,000 in cash from Zhu Delong at a rented apartment on Caiwang Street in Zhengzhou City.

In addition to assisting Xu Zhonghe in accepting and demanding bribes, defendant Fan Ganchao also took advantage of his position and on separate occasions accepted 7 items of gold jewelry, valued at approximately RMB 6,000, from Zhu Delong.

On August 8, 1988, defendants Xu Zhonghe and Fan Ganchao, taking advantage of their positions and on the pretext of needing operating expenses, demanded cash from the responsible person of the Liyuan Branch of the Provincial Coal Supply Company, a subordinate unit of the Liyuan Mining Bureau. Xu Zhonghe received RMB 10,000; Fan Ganchao received RMB 1,000. Between September 1988 and August 1989, Fan Ganchao, taking advantage of his position, embezzled over RMB 25,000 from freight charges for Liyuan Mining Bureau trucks; embezzled RMB 90,000 from the contract fees of the Liyuan Mining Bureau's Ningbo Sales Office; and, in collusion with others, using duplicate reimbursement methods, submitted a false invoice for the purchase of an automobile to the finance department for reimbursement of RMB 52,000, which they jointly embezzled.

Additionally, defendant Fan Ganchao, taking advantage of his position, between March 1988 and September 1989, on four separate occasions misappropriated public funds totaling over RMB 221,000 to purchase five Dongfeng brand trucks for use in profit-making activities by himself and others, from which Fan Ganchao obtained a profit of RMB 5,000.

After the case was uncovered, the following items were seized from defendant Xu Zhonghe: cash and bank deposit books totaling RMB 333,594; 14 gold items valued at RMB 27,867.84; one set of rosewood furniture valued at RMB 14,250; and one commercial housing unit valued at RMB 56,406. From defendant Fan Ganchao, the following were seized: illicit money of RMB 135,160 and 7 gold ornaments valued at RMB 6,480.79.

The above facts are confirmed by witness testimony, statements of the co-defendants, and the recovered illicit money and property, and are sufficiently established.

**Opinion of the Pingdingshan Intermediate People's Court:**
Defendant Xu Zhonghe, as a state functionary, took advantage of his position to demand and illegally accept property valued at RMB 475,067.84. His conduct constitutes the crime of bribery under Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Supplemental Provisions of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Concerning the Punishment of Crimes of Embezzlement and Bribery (hereinafter "Supplemental Provisions"). The amount of the bribe is especially huge and the circumstances of the crime are especially serious. Accordingly, he shall be severely punished according to Article 5, Paragraph 1 and Article 2, Item (1) of the Supplemental Provisions, and shall also have his political rights deprived for life according to Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the PRC. Xu Zhonghe, taking advantage of his position, embezzled public funds of RMB 10,000 from a subordinate unit and appropriated them for himself. His conduct constitutes the crime of embezzlement under Article 1, Paragraph 1 of the Supplemental Provisions, and he shall be punished according to Article 2, Item (2) of the Supplemental Provisions. Xu Zhonghe committed several crimes and shall be punished for them concurrently according to Article 64 of the Criminal Law.

Defendant Fan Ganchao, in collusion with Xu Zhonghe, took advantage of his position to conspire to and assist Xu Zhonghe in demanding and accepting bribes totaling RMB 453,063.04, and also himself illegally accepted bribes in the form of property valued at RMB 6,480.79. According to Article 4, Paragraph 2 of the Supplemental Provisions, he is an accomplice in the crime of bribery. Fan Ganchao, taking advantage of his position, embezzled public funds of RMB 168,160, of which he appropriated RMB 135,160 for himself; the amount is especially huge and the circumstances of the crime are especially serious, and he shall be severely punished according to Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Supplemental Provisions. Fan Ganchao misappropriated public funds amounting to RMB 221,262.46 for profit-making activities, personally obtaining a profit of RMB 5,000. This constitutes the crime of misappropriation of public funds under Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Supplemental Provisions, and the circumstances are serious, warranting severe punishment. Fan Ganchao, in order to curry favor with Xu Zhonghe, gave him one set of rosewood furniture valued at RMB 14,250. This constitutes the crime of offering bribes under Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Supplemental Provisions, and he shall be punished according to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Supplemental Provisions. According to Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, Fan Ganchao shall have his political rights deprived for life. Fan Ganchao committed several crimes and shall be punished for them concurrently according to Article 64 of the Criminal Law.

According to Article 12 of the Supplemental Provisions, the public property embezzled or misappropriated by defendants Xu Zhonghe and Fan Ganchao shall be recovered, and the profits obtained from accepting bribes and from the misappropriation of public funds shall be confiscated.

Accordingly, on October 13, 1993, the Pingdingshan Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment:
Defendant Xu Zhonghe: for the crime of bribery, sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; for the crime of embezzlement, sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of 8 years; for concurrent punishment for several crimes, decided to execute the death penalty, with deprivation of political rights for life; and it was ordered that the recovered illicit money, property, and some personal assets be confiscated.
Defendant Fan Ganchao: for the crime of embezzlement, sentenced to death, with a two-year suspension of execution, and deprivation of political rights for life; for the crime of bribery, sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of 15 years, with deprivation of political rights for 5 years; for the crime of misappropriation of public funds, sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of 12 years, with deprivation of political rights for 3 years; for the crime of offering bribes, sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of 4 years; for concurrent punishment for several crimes, decided to execute the death penalty, with a two-year suspension of execution, and deprivation of political rights for life; and it was ordered that the recovered illicit money, property, and some personal assets be confiscated.

Both defendants Xu Zhonghe and Fan Ganchao appealed against the first-instance judgment. Xu Zhonghe appealed on the grounds that the amounts determined for embezzlement and bribery were inaccurate, requesting a lenient sentence. Fan Ganchao appealed on the grounds that his actions were for the purpose of obtaining money for Xu Zhonghe and that he himself did not receive a single cent, thus not constituting the crime of bribery; and that the determination that he embezzled RMB 90,000 in contract fees was wrongful because most of that amount was given to Xu Zhonghe; he requested a lenient sentence.

**Opinion of the Henan High People's Court:**
The court of first instance clearly found the facts that Xu Zhonghe accepted bribes of over RMB 475,000 and embezzled RMB 10,000. These facts are confirmed by the statements of the co-defendant, numerous witness testimonies, and the recovered illicit money and property. The evidence is reliable and sufficient; Xu Zhonghe's appeal grounds are untenable. The facts that Fan Ganchao actively sought bribes for Xu Zhonghe and, in collusion with others, embezzled public funds by submitting false invoices are clear, and the evidence is reliable and sufficient. His claim that most of the embezzled contract fees were given to Xu Zhonghe was denied by Xu Zhonghe, and upon investigation, it could not be substantiated. Regarding the fact that Fan Ganchao instructed others to purchase rosewood furniture worth over RMB 14,000 for Xu Zhonghe: since the purchaser provided the over RMB 14,000 and the purchaser knew at the time of purchase that it was for Xu Zhonghe, this conduct should be characterized as Fan Ganchao and Xu Zhonghe jointly demanding bribes from the purchaser, and should be punished together with their crime of bribery. The first-instance court's separate characterization of this as the crime of offering bribes by Fan Ganchao was inappropriate and should be corrected. Accordingly, on October 24, 1993, the Henan High People's Court rendered the following judgment: The part of the original judgment convicting and sentencing Fan Ganchao for the crime of offering bribes is reversed; the remaining parts of the original judgment convicting and sentencing Xu Zhonghe for bribery and embezzlement, and Fan Ganchao for embezzlement, bribery, and misappropriation of public funds are affirmed.

Pursuant to Article 146 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, the Henan High People's Court approved the criminal judgment of the Pingdingshan Intermediate People's Court sentencing defendant Fan Ganchao to death, with a two-year suspension of execution, and deprivation of political rights for life. Pursuant to Article 144 of the Criminal Procedure Law, it reported the judgment affirming the first-instance sentence of death with deprivation of political rights for life for Xu Zhonghe to the Supreme People's Court for approval.

The Supreme People's Court, in accordance with the death penalty review procedure provided by the Criminal Procedure Law, reviewed the case. It held that the facts of defendant Xu Zhonghe's crimes as found by the original trial were clear, the evidence was reliable and sufficient, the conviction was accurate, the sentence was appropriate, and the trial procedure was lawful. By decision of the Adjudication Committee of the Supreme People's Court, on October 27, 1993, it issued a ruling approving the criminal judgment of the Henan High People's Court which affirmed the original judgment sentencing Xu Zhonghe to death for bribery with deprivation of political rights for life, and to fixed-term imprisonment of 8 years for embezzlement, with the concurrent punishment being execution of the death penalty with deprivation of political rights for life.
